body:
## Summary

Fixes Jhon-Crow/audio-recorder-with-visualization#109.

Preset rename was opened from a custom context menu, but the same click also reached the document-level click handler that hides the menu and clears `activePresetMenuId`. The rename action then ran without a preset id, so pressing Rename appeared to do nothing.

This change stops propagation for the preset context menu Rename/Delete buttons before hiding the menu, preserving the selected preset id for the action.

## Reproduction / Verification

Reproduced through the existing preset management Cypress flow: right-click a saved preset, choose Rename, and assert the preset button and persisted localStorage entry use the new name.

Automated coverage updated:
- `cypress/e2e/preset-management.cy.js` now also verifies the renamed preset is persisted in `audio-recorder-presets`.

Local checks run:
- `npm test`
- `npm run typecheck`
- `npm run lint`
- `npm run build`
- `npx cypress run --spec cypress/e2e/preset-management.cy.js`
